references.text: The preceding instruction from Moses to go up into the Negev and the mountains to explore the land.
Continuation of Moses' instructions regarding exploring the quality of the land, its cities, and people.
Moses' review of sending the spies to explore the land and its inhabitants.
Joshua sends spies to explore the land, especially Jericho, as a parallel to Moses' sending.
The spies' report about the people in the land—that they were strong and their cities fortified.
Description of the powerful nations living in the promised land.
Caleb and Joshua's positive report about the land and the people living there.
